$comment: Generated by scripts/gen-settings-registry.ts from the settings catalog and the settings registries; do not edit. Run `npm run gen:settings-registry` after changing either.

settings.label: Log Level
settings.help: Station writes server log entries at this severity and above, and drops quieter ones.

settings.label: Terminal shell
settings.help: Terminal sessions Station opens for you start in this shell instead of the host default.

settings.label: MCP UI host
settings.help: Tools that ship their own interface display it in chat inside a sandboxed frame instead of a plain unsupported notice.

settings.label: Surface trust from Veritas evidence
settings.help: A project’s Trust panel fills in from the newest Veritas evidence record in its workspace.

settings.label: Device helper URL
settings.help: Station lists this machine’s simulators and emulators through the device helper at this address.

settings.label: Registry URL
settings.help: The Registry page loads its catalog of agents, skills, and plugins from here.

settings.label: Disable default skill registries
settings.help: Only the skill registries you add yourself appear, and Station’s built-in catalogs are skipped.

settings.label: Layout sources
settings.help: After its next restart, Station offers projects only the layout sources named here.

settings.label: Usage telemetry
settings.help: Station sends the documented anonymous product-usage events only while this is on and a telemetry endpoint is configured.

settings.label: Approval guardian
settings.help: A second model screens tool calls that would pause for your approval and clears the safe ones so they run uninterrupted.

settings.label: Default approval mode
settings.help: New chats start in this approval posture unless the chat or its Agent names its own.

settings.label: Default model
settings.help: The Station-level fallback uses this model when neither the agent, the project, nor the model connection names one.

settings.label: Default Region
settings.help: Station picks this AWS region for Bedrock models when an agent does not name its own.

settings.label: Default Agent Instructions
settings.help: Every agent starts its context with these instructions, ahead of its own.

settings.label: Template Variables
settings.help: Agent instructions can reference these values as {{key}} instead of repeating them.

settings.label: Built-in agent engine
settings.help: Station’s built-in agents run on the engine you pick here, and keep using it until you change it.

settings.label: Default max turns
settings.help: Station stops an agent run once it has taken this many steps.

settings.label: Default max output tokens
settings.help: A model may produce at most this many tokens in one response, and empty means the model’s own limit applies.

settings.label: New chat workspace
settings.help: New chats in a project that names no workspace of its own run in this one.

settings.label: Workspace checkpoints
settings.help: After a restart, Station snapshots the session project’s directory in git each turn so later turns can be compared or recovered.

settings.label: Chat font size
settings.help: Chat messages render at this size on this device, ahead of the Station-configured default.

settings.label: Default chat font size
settings.help: Chat messages render at this size on devices that have not chosen their own.

settings.label: Answer delivery
settings.help: Only the optional features turned on here are active on this device, and this is where each notification category’s sound is kept.

settings.label: Show reasoning
settings.help: Chat messages on this device include the model’s reasoning steps.

settings.label: Show tool details
settings.help: Tool calls in chat on this device can be expanded to read their arguments and results.

settings.label: Auto-hide chat dock
settings.help: An idle, open chat dock collapses to its bar after five seconds on this device.

settings.label: Automatically show agent browser sessions
settings.help: Only the optional features turned on here are active on this device, and this is where each notification category’s sound is kept.

settings.label: Diff view style
settings.help: Changed files on this device show as one column or as two side-by-side columns.

settings.label: Diff line wrap
settings.help: Long diff lines wrap on this device instead of scrolling sideways.

settings.label: Ask before deleting a conversation
settings.help: When on, deleting a conversation on this device asks for confirmation first; deleting is not undoable either way.

settings.label: Theme
settings.help: The interface renders in this color scheme on this device.

settings.label: Sidebar sections
settings.help: The sidebar’s Open chats and Drafts sections reopen as you left them on this device.

settings.label: Haptic feedback
settings.help: A mobile shell pulses on streaming replies, copies, pairing success, and destructive confirms.

settings.label: Accent color
settings.help: Accent-colored interface elements use this color on this device instead of the theme’s own.

settings.label: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.help: Commands on this device respond to the keys you assigned instead of their default bindings.

settings.label: Push notifications
settings.help: Only the optional features turned on here are active on this device, and this is where each notification category’s sound is kept.

settings.label: Speech-to-text (microphone input)
settings.help: Speech you dictate on this device is transcribed by the service named here.

settings.label: Text-to-speech service

settings.label: Voice pill (speech-to-speech)
settings.help: Only the optional features turned on here are active on this device, and this is where each notification category’s sound is kept.

settings.label: Read replies aloud
settings.help: Only the optional features turned on here are active on this device, and this is where each notification category’s sound is kept.

settings.label: Mobile pairing & network discovery
settings.help: Only the optional features turned on here are active on this device, and this is where each notification category’s sound is kept.

settings.label: Open last Station on launch
settings.help: On this phone, Station reconnects to the Station you last selected when the app opens.
